div.div:
in the compiled XML each aggregate version carries its rank:
<orderings>
<ordering name="precedes"
index="1"/>
</orderings>

div.div: The rank is the length of the longest chain of predecessors. An XSLT sorts by it. If two names have different ranks, a chain must connect them; otherwise the ordering is rejected as not a strict weak order. A cycle is rejected too.
